content.short: jpg.store is a leading Cardano NFT marketplace for creators, collectors, minting, and wallet-based trading.
content.description: jpg.store is a major NFT marketplace for buying, selling, minting, and discovering NFTs on Cardano. The platform connects Cardano wallets so collectors can trade assets directly while creators can list collections, manage drops, and reach the wider CNFT market. It has become a central hub for Cardano artists, projects, and collectors because it combines marketplace listings, collection pages, search, wallet-based trading, and creator-focused tooling in one familiar interface for users and teams.
